{{Top|leg}}
The '''Meerian sign of greeting''' was a gesture in which both hands were held out, with palms up. It was a common salute among the [[Meerian/Legends|Meerians]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Near-Human]]s from the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]].
